entities.name: Ismail Mačev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ismail Mačev was a Macedonian sprinter who competed for Yugoslavia in the 400 metres. He took part in the 1988 Summer Olympics as well as two World Championships. In addition, he won a silver medal at the 1987 Mediterranean Games.
